formalism.claim: State space: rays in complex Hilbert space; observables: self-adjoint operators; composition: tensor product; dynamics: unitary evolution

primitives.claim: Hilbert-space structure and tensor-product composition are primitives, not derived
primitives.source: archive: REALITY_PICTURE_01 Q17 minimum input set includes 'quantum structure'

primitives.claim: The Born postulate is a primitive of the standard formulation
primitives.source: archive: 'QM ──ENCODES──▶ measurement statistics [T] CLOSED (Born as postulate)'
primitives.caveat: derivation programs exist and were audited: EC_BORN_01 Phase 2A found no route free of imported premises (abstract-level evidence only, hostile audit not executed)

primitives.claim: The local tensor factorization (which subsystems) is not intrinsic to the Hilbert space; spectrum-only recovery is uniqueness-given-existence, genericity-qualified
primitives.source: Cotler, Penington & Ranard, Commun. Math. Phys. 368, 1267 (2019), arXiv:1702.06142 — abstract verified 2026-09-23
primitives.caveat: existence of a k-local factorization is the conditional half

derived_objects.claim: Decoherence (suppression of interference in reduced states) is derived within closed unitary QM plus coarse-graining
derived_objects.source: archive: Experiment P repaired model, REALITY_CHECK_04 §10 ('produce reduced-state decoherence while preserving a pure global entangled state'); consistent with community decoherence theory (RC-05 C2)
derived_objects.caveat: tested model class: minimal closed s2⊗a2⊗eN with exact unitaries

derived_objects.claim: The uncertainty principle follows from an entropy bound on pure states (one-directional: the bound is strictly stronger, the reverse implication fails)
derived_objects.source: Carcassi & Aidala, Found. Phys. 52:40 (2022), arXiv:2111.09107 ('Reverse Physics: From Laws to Physical Assumptions', Sec. III) — full-text case extraction 2026-09-23; re-verified against full text 2026-09-23 (adversarial pass)
derived_objects.caveat: one degree of freedom in the source

empirical_inputs.claim: hbar is an input, not derived
empirical_inputs.source: archive: REALITY_PICTURE_01 Q17 minimum input set; program-side: 'hbar remained an irreducible input' in the tested GRUT program (baseline/synthesis record)

empirical_inputs.claim: Branch weights enter as initial-state data in the tested closed-unitary class — inherited, not dynamically derived
empirical_inputs.source: archive: REALITY_CHECK_04 §9-10 ('STATE_DEPENDENT / INHERITED FROM INITIAL AMPLITUDES / NOT DYNAMICALLY DERIVED, within the tested model class')
empirical_inputs.caveat: not a universal disproof of Born-rule derivability

constants.claim: hbar = 1.054571817...e-34 J s, exact: fixed by the 2019 SI redefinition via h = 6.62607015e-34 J s (exact)
constants.source: CODATA 2022 recommended values, NIST CUU (physics.nist.gov/cgi-bin/cuu/Value?hbar) -- page fetched 2026-09-23; standard uncertainty stated '(exact)'
constants.caveat: exact by definition since the 2019 SI redefinition; the empirical content moved into realizations of the kilogram (Kibble balance), so 'observed' refers to the pre-2019 measurement chain the definition froze

symmetries.claim: Symmetries are represented unitarily/antiunitarily on the state space (Wigner's theorem)
symmetries.source: Wigner, Gruppentheorie und ihre Anwendung auf die Quantenmechanik der Atomspektren (1931; Engl. transl. Academic Press 1959); rigorous proof closely following Wigner: Bargmann, J. Math. Phys. 5, 862-868 (1964), doi:10.1063/1.1704188 -- Bargmann record verified via ADS/AIP listing 2026-09-23
symmetries.caveat: applies to bijections of ray space preserving transition probabilities

QFT is recovered from QM + Lorentz invariance (constructively)
limits.caveat: no rigorous interacting 4D construction — recorded second-order gap (RAI_STRUCTURAL_THEORY_SEARCH §8)
